rv.q: It is a resurrection, and it is glorious.
Performer Arias’s brassy broad of a chanteuse is louche, luscious, and lascivious in all the right places.
Arias and Twist have created a show of pure imagination and unapologetic delight.

More story by association than cogent narrative, creators Arias and Twist have again brought the fun, laughs, theatricality, imagination, wonder, naughtiness, and coloring-outside-the-lines sensibility that made the show a success almost twenty years ago.

cn.t: Joey Arias and Basil Twist's downtown fantasia returns nearly two decades later with its imagination and joyful strangeness intact, proving to be a successful resurrection rather than mere nostalgia.
